summary: IDS feed c021_link has 2.92% packet loss on the path between SPAN destination and packet broker input, exceeding 0.1% threshold. IDS will miss attacks due to incomplete traffic.

findings.root_cause: Physical/link loss between LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 (SPAN destination) and NPB-01 port 1 (input): SPAN sent 4,907,100 packets but NPB input saw only 4,764,060 (143,040 packets / 2.92% lost). Most likely faulty cable/optic, dirty fiber, speed/duplex mismatch, or an unmonitored inline device dropping packets on that patch.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires complete bidirectional traffic with full payload for TCP reassembly and signature matching. 2.92% loss causes broken flows, missed sessions, and IDS evasion - significantly reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Loss occurs before the packet broker, so IDS never sees the missing packets. Inspect/replace cable and optics, clean fiber, verify speed/duplex and error counters on both ends, and remove any unmonitored tap/SPAN aggregation device on this link.
